name: initial loading stiffness
meaning_and_mapping: Initial virgin-compression branch slope; LIGGGHTS derives k1 from youngsModulus and radius. SE youngsModulus 18x softened (24->1.35 GPa) to compensate the missing hardness cap. (physical correspondence not exact internal-formula equality)

name: maximal/limit elastic stiffness
meaning_and_mapping: Un/reloading branch upper cap (k1<=k2<=k2_hat). Creates plastic residual overlap delta0. DIRECT 1:1 mapping. SE-SE cap 5.0 > AM-AM 1.5 = SE contacts stiffer-capped.

name: adhesion/cohesion stiffness
meaning_and_mapping: Adhesive branch slope -k_c*delta; lets contact bear TENSION (paper title). DIRECT 1:1 mapping. SE-SE 1e6 = 10x AM-AM 1e5 = SE cold-weld/vdW. MPM analog = --coh knob (backlog A3).

name: dimensionless plasticity depth
meaning_and_mapping: Sets plastic-flow limit overlap delta*_max. DIRECT 1:1 mapping. SE-SE 0.005 < AM-AM 0.05 = SE yields EARLIEST. Larger phi_f = yields later.

name: viscous (normal) damping
meaning_and_mapping: Viscous force gamma_0*v_n; r=exp(-eta0*t_c), eta0=gamma_0/(2*m12). Our r=0.3 < Luding recommended 0.4-0.8 (strong dissipation, ok for quasi-static compaction).

name: Coulomb friction
meaning_and_mapping: Tangential Cundall-Strack spring; adhesive limit mu_s*(f_n + k_c*delta). Our mu=0.5 all pairs. Fig4: friction has weak effect on tensile strength (k_c dominates).

name: rolling friction
meaning_and_mapping: Rolling resistance (mimics surface roughness/non-sphericity). Objective rolling velocity uses reduced radius.

name: characteristic velocity
meaning_and_mapping: LIGGGHTS-internal stiffness-interpolation reference velocity.

name: contact LAW selection
meaning_and_mapping: pair_style gran model hooke/hysteresis tangential history rolling_friction cdt = direct implementation of Luding eq6 (adhesive elasto-plastic hysteretic).

name: overlap definition
meaning_and_mapping: Normal overlap; n points j->i. Force f^c = f_n*n + f_t*t.

name: LSD non-adhesive normal force
meaning_and_mapping: Linear spring-dashpot baseline (non-cohesive).

name: restitution
meaning_and_mapping: omega=sqrt(k/m12 - eta0^2); recommended r 0.4-0.8.

name: adhesive elasto-plastic hysteretic force
units_or_form: f^hys = {k1*delta if k2(delta-delta0)>=k1*delta ; k2(delta-delta0) if k1*delta>k2(delta-delta0)>-k_c*delta ; -k_c*delta if -k_c*delta>=k2(delta-delta0)} ; f_n=f^hys+gamma_0*v_n
meaning_and_mapping: THE CORE = our contact LAW. Three branches: loading(k1)/unloading(k2)/adhesion(-k_c). k1<=k2<=k2_hat. Linear special case k1/k2_hat=1 (k_c,phi_f meaningless).

name: plastic residual overlap
meaning_and_mapping: = permanent plastic contact deformation = our epsilon_sphere 'displaced material' convention. delta_max = history variable (max overlap).

name: max attractive (adhesion) force
meaning_and_mapping: Most negative force on adhesive branch; k_c->inf limit f_min>=-(k2-k1)*delta_max.

name: plastic-flow limit overlap
meaning_and_mapping: Overlap above which constant k2_hat used; reduced radius 2a1a2/(a1+a2). Wall (a_wall=inf) -> smaller-particle diameter.

name: k2 interpolation
units_or_form: k2(delta_max) = k2_hat if delta_max>=delta*_max ; else k1+(k2_hat-k1)*delta_max/delta*_max
meaning_and_mapping: Weak contact=small plastic, strong contact=large plastic (linear approx of nonlinear hysteresis).

name: volume fraction after sintering
meaning_and_mapping: Coordination C=7.16 (sinter) -> 6.19/6.23 (relax). DIMENSIONLESS example, NOT transferable to LPSCl absolute porosity.

name: compressive vs tensile strength
meaning_and_mapping: k_c up -> tensile strength up + larger failure strain. Tension fails in bulk (weak k_c) or at wall (k_c/k=20).

name: license
meaning_and_mapping: OPEN ACCESS - freely citable. Replaces paywalled Walton-Braun 1986 (10.1122/1.549893) which Luding generalizes (refs 94,96).
